description: The NSQD+ deposit extends the National Stormwater Quality Database for a study of temporal trends. It supplies a workbook and two R scripts. This resource is provided by Simpson, Ian. M. Coverage is national as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists R, XLSX formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: It is a processed study subset or extension; users need to distinguish transformations from the original database. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epa-swmm. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
